name: Koca Mustafa Pasha Mosque
scope: Standing Koca Mustafa Pasha Mosque in Fatih, including the former Byzantine church envelope, the central octagonal drum, paired semidomes, five-domed portico and single west minaret.
era: Standing mosque after restoration, retaining its Byzantine and Ottoman exterior structure.

originalReview.notes: The scaled plan gives the relative position of the former church envelope, Turkish vestibule, elevated former chancel, central dome, opposed semidomes, and base of the minaret. The current heritage register records the restored portico bay count.

review.method: Exact published Qualla architectural plan and its documented first-edition source.
review.notes: The published Qualla plan is an exact native Commons scan of Van Millingen’s 1912 first edition. Architectural reports supply the later restoration and documented material facts. The model uses no modern reference photos.
